title: Two Minds Better Than One: Collaborative Reward Modeling for LLM Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2505.10597v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reward models (RMs) are central to aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values, yet noisy preference feedback can induce reward misgeneralization through spurious correlations and overfitting. We characterize the training dynamics of preference pairs and uncover a distinctive optimization signature of noise: persistently high losses, sharp temporal fluctuations, and irregular gradient updates. Our analyses further show that excluding such pairs improves downstream alignment. In practice, however, reliable preferences are not known a priori, and self-filtering based on a model's own training signals can amplify confirmation bias. To address this challenge, we introduce Collaborative Reward Modeling (CRM), an online framework for identifying reliable preferences. CRM couples cross-model peer review with curriculum learning: two RMs evaluate each other's sample selections, while curriculum keeps their learning progress

translated_title: 两心智胜过一心：面向大语言模型对齐的协作式奖励建模
translated_abstract: 奖励模型（RMs）对于将大语言模型（LLMs）与人类价值观对齐至关重要，然而噪声偏好反馈可能通过虚假关联和过拟合引发奖励的误泛化。我们刻画了偏好对的训练动态，并揭示了噪声的独特优化特征：持续的高损失、剧烈的时间波动以及不规则的梯度更新。我们的分析进一步表明，排除此类样本对可以改善下游对齐效果。然而在实践中，可靠的偏好无法先验得知，而基于模型自身训练信号的自过滤可能会加剧确认偏误。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了协作式奖励建模，这是一种用于识别可靠偏好的在线框架。CRM将跨模型互评与课程学习相结合：两个奖励模型相互评估对方的样本选择，同时课程学习保持它们的学习进度。
tldr: 提出协作式奖励建模（CRM）框架，通过两个奖励模型跨模型互评结合课程学习来识别可靠的偏好数据，从而有效缓解噪声偏好导致的奖励误泛化并提升大语言模型的对齐效果。
